# dagsterplus Provider

Interact with Dagster+ (Dagster Cloud) to manage deployments, code locations, and teams.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The Dagster+ API token. May also be set via DAGSTER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Override the base URL for the Dagster+ API (e.g. for on-prem or custom deployments). Defaults to https://{organization}.dagster.cloud.
- `organization` (String) The Dagster+ organization name (e.g. 'my-org' for my-org.dagster.cloud). May also be set via DAGSTER_CLOUD_ORGANIZATION environment variable.
